title: Model Signal Qualifier and Niche Prospectivity Playbook
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Problem: our model-scouting stream captures a high volume of signals (new flavours, quantization indicators, latency regressions, vendor release notes) but lacks a lightweight, repeatable way to rank which signals should convert into procurement, benchmarking, or rapid-probe work. This ticket scopes a 'Model Signal Qualifier' and an accompanying playbook to: 1) score incoming model-supply signals by prospectivity (likelihood of being valuable to Redwood customers), risk (migration cost, latency delta), and operational feasibility (quantization/hardware fit); 2) provide deterministic rules to escalate signals into PM/ENG field probes; and 3) produce a compact market-recon deliverable for sales/SRE/solutions teams.
deliverables: 1) Scoring rubric (prospectivity / risk / feasibility) and implementation spec; 2) Small ETL pipeline that enriches model-scout events with scoring metadata and a daily top-20 watchlist; 3) Playbook doc templates for rapid probes (bench plan, customer impact matrix, roll-off criteria); 4) Dashboard cards in Signal Hub with alerts and triage links; 5) Runbook for how PM, Eng, and Solutions act on top signals.
success_metrics: - 60% of escalated signals should be actionable (resulting in a benchmark or vendor outreach) within two weeks; - Median time-to-escalation reduced from 9 days to <=48 hours for P1 signals; - Sales/SE survey > 80% find the weekly watchlist relevant; - Reduce duplicate scout items by 30% via normalization.
acceptance_criteria: Scoring rubric documented and reviewed (PM + Research + Eng)
Pipeline prototype produces daily watchlist (CSV/BigQuery) with score and reason fields
Dashboard card shows top-20 signals and links to playbook templates
On-call SRE/Bench owner can follow playbook and record outcome tags
Stakeholder walkthrough completed with Sales, Solutions, and SRE; feedback incorporated
